verdict.rationale: BILL documents narrow, product-native rule-to-action automation. Bill approval policies are rule sets that decide which bills need approval, by whom, and when. Vendor autopay pays a vendor automatically when a bill is created, and tolerance rules plus automatic 2/3-way matching act on purchasing events. Webhooks only notify external systems, so they are a building block rather than user-defined automation, and most of these rules are AP-oriented, not Spend & Expense-specific. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable trigger/condition/action rule engine, Spend & Expense-specific event rules (e.g., card transaction triggers), detailed rule configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
